events.title: Salem 400+ Heritage Days Parade
events.description: The Salem Heritage Days Parade returns after 30+ years as part of Salem's 400+ celebration. Free, family-friendly; parade begins at the O'Keefe Center and ends at Salem Maritime National Historical Park, with a festival featuring food trucks, music, lawn games and family activities.

events.title: Boston Race Amity Arts & Music Festival
events.description: Free fifth-annual outdoor festival on the Rose Kennedy Greenway at Rowes Wharf, with a diverse musical lineup, a community art project, handmade arts and crafts from local artists, and free ice cream from Ben and Jerry's. The festival celebrates cross-racial friendship and collaboration; all ages welcome.
